title: Kast and CAF Agree $6 Billion, Four-Year Investment Agenda
detail: President Kast met with CAF (Development Bank of Latin America) executive president Sergio Díaz-Granados at La Moneda and agreed a joint work agenda worth US$6 billion over four years, targeting capital-market reform support, housing and employment, infrastructure (railways, metro, ports), water and sanitation access, and border security and customs management. CAF said it would 'accompany that process, not only with financial resources, but also through project structuring and mobilization of private capital toward strategic sectors,' as the government sought outside financing momentum for its stalled economic agenda.

media.caption: Kast and CAF's Sergio Díaz-Granados announce a $6B, four-year investment agenda — September 15, 2026

title: Kast Previews Labor Emergency Plan to Ruling Coalition Leaders
detail: Facing 9.5% unemployment (May–July quarter), President Kast met ruling-coalition party leaders — Evópoli's Luciano Cruz-Coke, RN's Andrea Balladares, UDI's Guillermo Ramírez and the Republicans' Arturo Squella — at La Moneda to preview a multi-ministry 'emergency labor plan' spanning Finance, Labor, Public Works, Housing and the regional-development subsecretariat. The plan, to be formally presented after Fiestas Patrias, would combine subsidies and accelerated public-works, housing and regional projects aimed at job creation through the end of the year; coalition leaders committed to fast-track any resulting legislation.

media.caption: Kast previews a labor emergency plan to ruling-coalition leaders as unemployment hits 9.5% — September 15, 2026
